nominal_basis: Previously predetermined March3 training-day profile nearest50m; scenario1 in preserved calibration_report.json; no model-performance selection

equations.physical_comparison: At identical original sample indices, retain sound-speed range displacement separately from Sv coefficient change; no acoustic-field interpolation claim

envelope.source_selection: All four recovered SIT units and existing daily composite over original complete167-day calendar; environmental measurements only
envelope.SIT_QC: Finite T/SP/P/depth with all associated publisher flags1 or2; preserve rejected counts
envelope.composite_QC: Finite converted T/SP/P; source lacks per-profile quality flags so these only widen plausibility envelope, not certify local water
envelope.rectangular_bounds: Min/max over all accepted regional measurements, independently expanded in each variable; no quantile trimming or acoustic score selection
envelope.allowance_status: Conservative engineering allowances exceeding quoted initial CTD precision; scientific adequacy requires reviewer acceptance, not formal uncertainty coverage
envelope.samples: All8 T/SP/P corners plus17 evenly spaced levels on each axis (4913 grid points); grid maximum is not a mathematical continuous bound

evaluation.range_sampling: 181 evenly spaced0.5m points plus actual finite training-segment sample positions
evaluation.support: Original38kHz finite training range must contain10–100m under every corner; support at band edges must remain invariant
evaluation.other_channels: Report all; no other channel may rescue a failed38kHz gate
evaluation.real_reference: Fixed training file20030300.01A only; compare corner Sv differences to pinned upstream calibration and independent scalar difference equation

decision: Any failed bound retains physical block. A passing sampled envelope is candidate evidence requiring independent adequacy/continuous-bound review; no automatic corpus promotion.
remaining_even_if_passed: Calibrated upstream adapter and mandatory QC artifacts
R0/R1 independent approval and real eligible-day counts
forecast_availability: Fixed calibration metadata only; no measured future or retrospective environmental covariates enter predictor inputs. No acoustic test arrays are read.
